rows.labelKm: កំណើនតាមរយៈពេល
rows.definition: Event creation in selected interval versus immediately preceding interval of equal calendar days
rows.dateDimension: createdAt in Phnom Penh calendar windows
rows.missingDataBehavior: Null; NEW_ACTIVITY when prior=0 and current>0, NO_ACTIVITY when both=0

rows.labelKm: តម្លៃបញ្ជាទិញរង់ចាំ
rows.calculation: SUM(expected_amount) for pending/review records GROUP BY currency
rows.missingDataBehavior: Unknown currency never becomes USD

rows.labelKm: គណនីមានប្រាក់ទទួលបានផ្ទៀងផ្ទាត់
rows.definition: Payment classification of the selected registration cohort; not an entitlement/free-plan label
rows.calculation: COUNT users with at least one lifetime MATCHED order with confirmedReceipt>0; noVerifiedReceiptUsers is the complementary cohort count
rows.databaseSource: users LEFT JOIN unified matched payment ledger
rows.dateDimension: User registration cohort; lifetime verified purchase history
rows.includedStatuses: Nondeleted accounts; positive trusted matched cash
rows.excludedStatuses: Zero-value orders, free entitlement alone, pending, duplicate and unverified payment claims
rows.currencyBehavior: Positive receipt in either explicit currency; no currency amounts added
rows.missingDataBehavior: No positive verified receipt does not prove a free plan or absence of unverified claims
